CR-067 phase 1 field probe
Select all, press F9, then save as described in README.txt. Each case: its token, then the field. A field Word leaves alone still says OLD.
A bookmark: Bookmarked text. A footnote reference: [1].
Case 1: P01_CREATEDATE { CREATEDATE }
P01_CREATEDATE = 2/3/2024 1:05:00 PM
Case 2: P02_CREATEDATE_SW { CREATEDATE \@ "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" }
P02_CREATEDATE_SW = 2024-02-03 13:05
Case 3: P03_SAVEDATE { SAVEDATE }
P03_SAVEDATE = 6/7/2025 5:09:00 PM
Case 4: P04_SAVEDATE_SW { SAVEDATE \@ "d MMMM yyyy" }
P04_SAVEDATE_SW = 7 June 2025
Case 5: P05_REVNUM { REVNUM }
P05_REVNUM = 7
Case 6: P06_INFO_TITLE { INFO Title }
P06_INFO_TITLE = Probe Title
Case 7: P07_INFO_AUTHOR { INFO Author }
P07_INFO_AUTHOR = Probe Author
Case 8: P08_INFO_NOARG { INFO }
P08_INFO_NOARG = OLD
Case 9: P09_INFO_NOPE { INFO Nope }
P09_INFO_NOPE = OLD
Case 10: P10_SECTION { SECTION }
P10_SECTION = 1
Case 11: P11_QUOTE { QUOTE "hello world" }
P11_QUOTE = hello world
Case 12: P12_QUOTE_NOARG { QUOTE }
P12_QUOTE_NOARG = 
Case 13: P13_REF { REF bm1 }
P13_REF = Bookmarked text
Case 14: P14_REF_UPPER { REF bm1 \* Upper }
P14_REF_UPPER = BOOKMARKED TEXT
Case 15: P15_REF_NOPE { REF nope }
P15_REF_NOPE = OLD
Case 16: P16_REF_H { REF bm1 \h }
P16_REF_H = Bookmarked text
Case 17: P17_NOTEREF { NOTEREF bmNote }
P17_NOTEREF = 1
Case 18: P18_NOTEREF_F { NOTEREF bmNote \f }
P18_NOTEREF_F = 1
Case 19: P19_NOTEREF_NOPE { NOTEREF nope }
P19_NOTEREF_NOPE = OLD
Case 20: P20_USERNAME { USERNAME }
P20_USERNAME = OLDUSER
Case 21: P21_USERINITIALS { USERINITIALS }
P21_USERINITIALS = OLDUSER
Case 22: P22_USERADDRESS { USERADDRESS }
P22_USERADDRESS = OLDUSER
Case 23: P23_KEYWORDS { KEYWORDS }
P23_KEYWORDS = alpha, beta

Case 24: P24_SECTION2 { SECTION }
P24_SECTION2 = 2
Case 25: P25_CREATEDATE_SIMPLE { CREATEDATE \@ "yyyy-MM-dd" }
P25_CREATEDATE_SIMPLE = 2024-02-03
[1] The probe's footnote.
